witness.note: The Newberry Library dates Francisco Ximénez’s surviving K’iche’–Spanish transcription to 1700–1715 in Chichicastenango, Guatemala. This dates the surviving witness, not the earlier K’iche’ composition or living oral tradition. The text is not evidence that its stories originated in 1700.
